events.title: Demo update 0.0.6
events.summary: TL/DR: Ghost rocks fixed, the geologist rocks are in the game, climbable crates, and a lot of fixes. Thank you to everyone who sent reports! New Geologist reviewed rocks are now in the game! You can find them in a new tab in the journal. You can now pick up rocks through some objects. You can now change the render scale when you start the game. You can now climb onto crates. Changes The UI now scales with your screen (for 1440p and 4K monitors). events.title: Demo update 0.0.5
events.summary: TL/DR: An OpenGL option, a harder challenge mode, and a lot of fixes. Thank you to everyone who sent reports! New New "OpenGL" option for some older computers. The records page now explains the different types of runs. Fixes Improved the rock fizz animation. The bug report form now shows where to read the privacy policy. events.title: Demo update 0.0.4
events.summary: Runs better, Steam achievements and leaderboards, and a lot of fixes. Thank you to everyone who sent reports! Runs better The game uses about 40% less memory on low. The main hall has about a third fewer triangles. You can pick your graphics setting on launch. Loading is quicker and now has a progress bar. Fixed lag when flipping the journal and opening settings. Low and medium both run a lot faster now. New custom graphics settings let you fine tune your game. New All achievements are now on St

events.title: Demo update 0.0.3
events.summary: Special thanks to everyone who sent a crash report! This update fixes the crashes you found. Issues resolved: Fixed a crash when marking a rock in the journal or picking up a key. Fixed a crash in the settings after going back to the title from a game. Fixed a rare crash when fitting a vase piece right after scratching it with the knife.
